## Purpose

<!-- hand:purpose -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

How the simulation is shown and heard: the renderer (sweep lanes, numeric tiles, the alarm header, the 12-lead view),
audio (QRS and pulse tones, alarm sounds, device tones), skins (each monitor's look and behaviour as data) and the demo
app with its physiology console. There is no physiology here: it draws and sounds what the engine and the device layer
publish. A clinician-educator can see why the screen and sound behave like a monitor; an embedding developer gets the
renderer, audio and skin contracts.
<!-- /hand:purpose -->

## Equations in words

<!-- hand:equations -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

- Sweep position comes from sim time, never from frame counts: x = (simT · mm/s · px/mm) mod lane width, with a default
  of 96 CSS px per inch (3.78 px/mm) until the user calibrates (`packages/renderer/src/calibration.ts`; research/05
  §3.1).
- Each device-pixel column keeps its first, last, minimum and maximum sample, so QRS and VF crests are never averaged
  away (`packages/renderer/src/decimate.ts`).
- A pressure lane maps its scale range [lo, hi] to baseline = hi/(hi − lo) and gain = height/((hi − lo)·px/mm); the
  pleth is auto-scaled (`packages/renderer/src/wave-lanes.ts`).
- Display units: displayed value = engine value × scale, e.g. mmHg·s/mL to dyn·s/cm⁵
  (`apps/demo/src/physiology-console/meta.ts`, `apps/demo/src/app/vitals.ts`).
- Clock mapping: wallMs(t) = anchorWall + (t − anchorSim)·1000/timeScale and audioTime = contextTime + (wallMs −
  performanceTime)/1000 (`packages/audio/src/clock-map.ts`; web.dev "A tale of two clocks").
- A 25 ms timer schedules every tone due in the next 100 ms; a late tone plays at once, and a QRS tone is dropped only
  if it would sound more than 150 ms after its R wave (`packages/audio/src/scheduler.ts`).
- The QRS/pulse beep is 60 ms, sine plus second harmonic, at a fixed 880 Hz or pitched by SpO2 as
  baseHz·2^(−(100 − SpO2)·s/12) with s 0.1 ('nellcor-like') or 0.4 ('enhanced') semitone per %
  (`packages/audio/src/tones.ts`, `packages/audio/src/profiles/pitch-maps.ts`; research 03 §3.6, 05 §2.5).
- The engine's `alarmStatus` event is the single source of alarm sound: only the highest priority sounds (ties: first
  raised), and acknowledged alarms are silent (`packages/renderer/src/alarm-audio.ts`).
- A skin resolves as base ← skin ← preset ← theme; objects merge key by key, arrays and scalars replace
  (`packages/skins/src/resolve.ts`, `packages/skins/src/merge.ts`).
<!-- /hand:equations -->
